description: Upgrade card catalog for ROBOCUS (Scrapyard Dominus & Arena Sandbox). Maps directly to Sim keys, slots, strain values, and market/crate tiers.

cards.name: Autocannon
cards.effect: Standard ballistic gun. Uses installed calibre (rapid, medium, heavy).

cards.name: Laser Retrofit
cards.effect: Continuous beam (280 px range), 60% of firepower/s, ignores armour, pierces robots in path, stopped by enemy energy walls.

cards.name: Mortar Retrofit
cards.effect: Lobbed shell (0.45 shots/s, min range 110 px, 45 px splash radius). Lobs over energy walls.

cards.name: Saw Blade Launcher
cards.effect: Fires ricocheting discs (1.1/s) that bounce off arena walls, energy walls, and robots up to 3 hits. Never hurts own squad.

cards.name: Flamethrower
cards.effect: Short 140 px fire cone (50% fp/s, ignores armour) that sets robots burning (5 dmg/s true damage, spreads on contact).

cards.name: Spinner Blade
cards.effect: Spinning melee disc (+15% charge speed). Contact deals 0.75x fp + knockback + 0.35s stun. Deflects 25% of bullets and saws.

cards.name: Prototype Railgun
cards.effect: Legendary hitscan slug (0.4 shots/s, 450 px range). Pierces all targets and walls; ignores 50% of armour.

cards.name: Rapid-Fire Kit
cards.effect: Gun fires 4 shots/s, bullet speed x1.3, turret turn x1.25, +8% dmg. Shreds unarmoured bots; weak vs armour.

cards.name: Balanced Receiver
cards.effect: Standard 1.4 shots/s gun receiver with balanced shell speed and turret turn.

cards.name: Heavy Cannon Kit
cards.effect: Gun fires 0.5 shots/s, shell speed x0.6, turret turn x0.55, needs 3 deg aim. Punches through heavy armour.

cards.name: Energy Shield
cards.effect: Hidden module: 25 HP bubble absorbs damage before armour; recharges 10 HP/s after 3 s unhit.

cards.name: Decoy Hologram
cards.effect: Hidden module: at 60% HP, spawns a hologram copy for 2.5 s that draws enemy fire.

cards.name: Smoke Screen
cards.effect: Hidden module: at 50% HP, pops a 4 s smoke cloud that causes incoming shots to spread wildly.

cards.name: Repair Drone
cards.effect: Hidden module: heals 6 HP/s after 1.2 s without taking a hit (up to 35% of max HP).

cards.name: Mine Layer
cards.effect: Hidden module: drops a proximity mine every 1.6 s while driving (max 5, 22 dmg to anyone outside own squad).

cards.name: EMP Burst
cards.effect: Hidden module: when an enemy enters 130 px, stuns all enemies within 150 px for 1.8 s (12 s cooldown).

cards.name: Hydraulic Flipper
cards.effect: Hidden module: charges in every 3 s; contact deals 14 dmg, throws enemy back, and stuns 1.3 s (+8 wall slam).

cards.name: Self-Destruct Core
cards.effect: Hidden module: rams nearest enemy below 30% HP; explodes on death for up to 45 dmg within 90 px.

cards.name: Reflective Plating
cards.effect: Phase 2 module: reflects 50% of laser damage back at the shooter and halves fire buildup.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.effect: Phase 2 module: every 8 s, yanks target within 240 px toward this robot (140 px pull + 0.4 s stun).

cards.name: Jump Jets
cards.effect: Phase 2 module: every 7 s, leaps 160 px away when cornered (<90 px) or targeted by a mortar shell.

cards.name: Oil Slick Dispenser
cards.effect: Phase 2 module: drops a 65 px oil puddle at <=65% HP (turn rate x0.25, slides; ignites if hit by flame).

cards.name: Medic Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (18 HP): trails behind owner and heals 4 HP/s (max 8 HP/s from medics).

cards.name: Waller Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (40 HP): rides in front and drops a 40 HP energy wall every 5 s (stops enemy bullets & lasers).

cards.name: Bodyguard Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (60 HP, 2 Armour, size 26): parks between owner and enemy to soak bullets.

cards.name: Gun Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (30 HP): orbits owner and fires 2 shots/s of 3 dmg at owner's target.

cards.name: Spotter Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (25 HP): +15% owner accuracy, sees through smoke, reveals enemy modules within 220 px.

cards.name: Jammer Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (25 HP): flies toward enemy; enemies within 160 px turn turrets at 45% speed.

cards.name: Bomber Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (20 HP): after 2 s, dives at owner's target and explodes for 24 dmg within 50 px.

cards.name: Miner Drone
cards.effect: Open helper (30 HP): circles owner dropping a 24 dmg proximity mine every 1.6 s (max 5).

cards.name: Reinforced Hull
cards.effect: +1 Health level (+25 HP, -4% speed from weight).

cards.name: Armour Plate
cards.effect: +1 Armour level (+1.5 flat damage reduction per hit, -9% speed from weight).

cards.name: Tuned Engine
cards.effect: +1 Speed level (+35 px/s base speed). Adds +1 overdrive strain at level 4+.

cards.name: Turret Motor
cards.effect: +1 Turret turn level. Adds +1 overdrive strain at level 4+.

cards.name: High-Output Core
cards.effect: +1 Firepower level. Adds +1 overdrive strain at level 4+.

cards.name: Targeting Chip
cards.effect: +1 Accuracy level.

cards.name: Long Barrel
cards.effect: +1 Bullet speed level.

cards.name: Zigzag Evasion Chip
cards.effect: Rapid 0.45 s lateral reversals, 1.25x strafe weight, and +35 deg serpentine weave when closing range.

cards.name: Kiter Logic Chip
cards.effect: Retreats at 1.1x radial weight when enemies close within 75% of preferred range, firing backward while backing away.

cards.name: Rammer Aggression Chip
cards.effect: Ignores enemy spacing, charges straight to contact (range 0), and deals collision knockback + impact damage.

cards.name: Heavy Tank Tracks
cards.effect: 260 deg/s pivot turn, ignores 50% of armour/HP weight penalty, 50% knockback resistance, 0.90x top speed.

cards.name: Omni-Drive
cards.effect: 100% sideways movement regardless of hull facing (align = 1.0), 0.92x base speed, takes 1.35x knockback.

cards.name: Overboost Thrusters
cards.effect: 1.15x base speed + 1.6x dash burst for 0.6 s every 4.5 s; wider turns (135 deg/s hull turn).
